events.text:
Objetivo observado

Observação: A visible confirmed reservation was completed and re-checked: Willow for 'Quarterly planning', Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 (one hour), 12 people, Projector Included, with a $245 all-charges-included total, shown both on the confirmation card (evidence #20) and in My reservations (evidence #22).

Interpretação simulada: Gather's guided planner, room comparison with itemized all-in totals, review summary and saved-reservations check allowed a first-time visitor to complete and verify the requested test booking without exceeding budget.

Limites: The booking is explicitly a demo reservation saved only in this browser session, with no payment taken; the date is displayed as 'Tomorrow' rather than a calendar date. No obstacle or defect was observed in the explored flow.

Capturas indicadas: #8, #10, #18, #20, #22. A correspondência com a evidência requer revisão humana.
events.interpretation: Relato do modelo; capturas e conclusões exigem revisão humana.

findings.title: Willow met capacity, projector, duration and budget requirements
findings.observation: Willow was listed with 12 seats and Projector at a $245 total, described in review as Room · 1 hour $235, Projector $0, Service charge $10, Total $245 with all charges included.
findings.expected: A room for 12 people with a projector for a one-hour slot, with complete cost at or below $350.
findings.expectedSource: Persona's explicit meeting requirements in the saved mission.
findings.personaComment: Willow gave me the same seats and projector for less, so that felt like the safer choice for the budget.
findings.interpretation: Willow satisfied every stated constraint with $105 left under the budget limit, and its projector was included at $0 rather than added later.
findings.uncertainty: The date was shown only as 'Tomorrow' rather than a calendar date, which was sufficient for the requested available one-hour slot in this test.

findings.title: Step labels and persistent booking summary supported first-time confidence
findings.observation: The flow showed steps 'Your plans / Choose a room / Your meeting / Review'; the planner showed 12 people, checked projector and 10:00–11:00, and later screens repeatedly summarized Willow, 12 people, projector included and $245 total.
findings.expected: A first-time visitor should see recognizable labels, clear next steps, and be able to check details before confirming.
findings.expectedSource: Persona expectations for a useful introduction, recognizable labels, clear next steps, and confirmation of what has been saved.
findings.personaComment: I could see all my requirements in the summary while I added the meeting name.
findings.interpretation: The step labels and persistent summary reduced the need to remember earlier choices, making it easier for a first-time visitor to verify capacity, projector and price before committing.
findings.uncertainty: This is a single synthetic first-time journey; no claim is made about other users' comprehension.

findings.title: Confirmed reservation was saved and re-verified in My reservations
findings.observation: The confirmation card showed Confirmed status, 'Quarterly planning', Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included and $245 total; My reservations then listed the same Quarterly planning booking at Willow for 12 people with Projector, Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, $245.
findings.expected: The final saved reservation should visibly match the requested meeting purpose, attendees, projector and all-in budget.
findings.expectedSource: Persona success criteria: verify a visible confirmed reservation with Quarterly planning, 12 attendees, a projector, and an all-in total within $350.
findings.personaComment: That confirmation matches everything — and it appears in my saved reservations too.
findings.interpretation: Both the confirmation screen and the saved reservations list provided independent visible evidence that the completed test reservation matched the mission.
findings.uncertainty: The footer states this is a demo venue and reservations are saved only in this browser session, so persistence beyond the session was not tested.

finding.interpretation: Gather's guided planner, room comparison with itemized all-in totals, review summary and saved-reservations check allowed a first-time visitor to complete and verify the requested test booking without exceeding budget.

learnings.confidenceBasis: Screenshots 8, 10, 12, 18, 20 and 22 each show successive labelled steps in the same booking flow; the sequence was executed in this journey.
learnings.content: In Gather, booking proceeds from 'Plan a meeting' through 'What's the plan?', 'See available rooms', choosing a room, entering a meeting name, 'Review booking', 'Confirm reservation', then optionally 'View my reservations' to verify the saved booking.
learnings.name: Gather booking flow order
learnings.subject: Gather booking flow
learnings.value: Plan a meeting -> plan details -> choose room -> meeting name -> review -> confirm -> My reservations verification

learnings.confidenceBasis: Screenshot 10 shows Willow's $245 total and breakdown on the room card; screenshot 18 repeats Room $235, Projector $0, Service $10, Total $245 all charges included.
learnings.content: Willow was shown as a 12-seat workshop room with Projector and a $245 all-in total for the selected one-hour meeting: $235 room + $0 projector + $10 service.
learnings.name: Willow observed price and fit
learnings.subject: Willow room total and requirements

learnings.confidenceBasis: Screenshot 20 shows the Confirmed card with all requested fields and $245; screenshot 22 shows the same booking listed under My reservations.
learnings.content: A confirmed Quarterly planning reservation for Willow was verified both on the confirmation card and in My reservations with Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector/Included and $245.
learnings.name: Saved reservation verification
learnings.subject: Confirmed reservation display
learnings.value: Confirmation and My reservations both display the saved Quarterly planning Willow booking details

persona.name: Sam · First-time visitor
persona.description: A fictional first-time visitor from Home v3 who needs a clear introduction and next steps.
persona.label: Sam · First-time visitor
persona.context: You have been asked to arrange the team’s quarterly planning meeting. This is your first room-booking task in Gather, and you need to understand how to get started from the information the app provides.
persona.mission: Book a room for 12 people with a projector for the available one-hour meeting slot. Enter the meeting purpose Quarterly planning. Keep the complete cost at or below $350.
persona.initialKnowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.knowledge: You have not used Gather before. You know the meeting requirements, but have no walkthrough, knowledge of its rooms or prices, or prior reservation.
persona.constraints: You need seats for all 12 people and a projector. The complete cost, including any fees and equipment, must not exceed $350. Use only the fictional meeting details.
persona.skills: Comfortable browsing websites and entering ordinary form fields. Unfamiliar with Gather’s navigation and booking terminology.
persona.decision: Read enough introductory information to understand the task, compare suitable room details, and choose using information available in the interface. Look for help if a next step is unclear.
persona.resources: A desktop browser and fictional meeting details; no real account or payment information.
persona.expectations: A useful introduction, recognizable labels, clear next steps, and confirmation of what has been saved.
persona.priorities: Understand the booking process, choose a suitable room, and complete the reservation confidently.
persona.successCriteria: Verify a visible confirmed reservation with the requested meeting purpose, 12 attendees, a projector, and an all-in total within $350. Report any missing or uncertain detail accurately.
persona.stopCriteria: Stop after a verified suitable reservation, a supported obstacle after reasonable recovery, an unsafe action, or the session limits. Do not book beyond your budget or claim success without visible evidence.

limitations: Synthetic persona observations. Completion is distinct from achieving the goal.

experience.observation: Two meeting rooms are shown: Atlas at $280 total and Willow at $245 total, each listing 12 seats and Projector with itemized costs and 'Available tomorrow'.
experience.reaction: Both options look within budget on paper — I'll start the planner to see the steps and confirm the hour.

feedback.summary: Room cards showing 12 seats, Projector, and itemized all-in totals make the budget fit easy to compare
feedback.why: Atlas shows $280 total ($220 + $35 projector + $25 service) and Willow shows $245 total ($235 + $0 projector + $10 service), both at or below my $350 limit with nothing added later.

experience.observation: The 'What's the plan?' form shows Tomorrow, 10:00–11:00, 12 people, a checked projector option, and 'One hour' with a 'See available rooms' button.
experience.reaction: This is reassuringly clear — the defaults already match my group, so I'll see which rooms fit.

feedback.summary: Planner defaults of 12 people, checked projector, and 10:00–11:00 match the required one-hour meeting
feedback.why: The form shows '12 people', a checked 'We need a projector', Time '10:00–11:00' and 'One hour', so I do not need to change any requirement before proceeding.

experience.observation: The room-choice step repeats Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people and Projector required, listing Atlas at $280 total and Willow at $245 total, both with 12 seats and Projector.
experience.reaction: Willow gives me the same seats and projector for less, so that feels like the safer choice for the budget.

feedback.summary: Filtered rooms restate 12 people, projector required, and all-in totals, making Willow's $245 fit clear
feedback.why: The summary bar shows Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector required, and Willow lists 12 seats, Projector and $245 total ($235 + $0 projector + $10 service), below my $350 limit.

experience.observation: The 'Your meeting' step has a 'Meeting name' field with placeholder 'e.g. Quarterly planning' and a Willow summary showing Tomorrow, 10:00–11:00, 12 people, projector included, and $245 total.
experience.reaction: I can see all my requirements in the summary while I add the meeting name.

feedback.summary: Persistent Willow summary with date, time, 12 people, projector and $245 all-in total lets me verify before naming the meeting
feedback.why: The side panel shows Tomorrow, 10:00–11:00, People 12, 'Projector Included in your booking' and Total $245 with 'All charges included', so the key constraints stay visible at this step.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field is focused with a blue outline, and the Willow booking summary remains visible on the right.
experience.reaction: I'll enter 'Quarterly planning' as the meeting name.

experience.observation: The Meeting name field now shows 'Quarterly planning', with a 'Review booking' button and the Willow $245 summary still visible.
experience.reaction: The name looks right — I'll check the full review before I confirm anything.

experience.observation: The Review step shows Meeting name 'Quarterly planning', projector and seating for 12, and the Willow summary for Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 with Total $245, all charges included.
experience.reaction: Everything matches what I was asked for, so I'm comfortable confirming this one.

feedback.summary: Review screen restating meeting name, projector, seating for 12 and $245 all-in total supports confident confirmation
feedback.why: It shows 'Quarterly planning', 'includes a projector' and 'seating for 12', plus Willow Tomorrow 10:00–11:00 for 12 people at Total $245 'All charges included', which is within my $350 budget.

experience.observation: A confirmed reservation card for Willow shows 'Quarterly planning', Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, 12 people, Projector Included, $245 all charges included, and reservation code GTH-2E4F9780.
experience.reaction: That confirmation matches everything — I'll just check it appears in my saved reservations too.

feedback.summary: Confirmation card showing Confirmed status, 12 people, projector included and $245 total verifies the booking matches the request
feedback.why: The card reads 'Quarterly planning is booked at Willow' with Tomorrow 10:00–11:00, People 12, Projector Included, Reservation total $245 all charges included, and a reservation code.

charterSnapshot.name: Book a room that fits
charterSnapshot.mission: Explore Gather from the selected persona’s point of view and reserve a room satisfying their meeting requirements and spending limit. Verify the final reservation details. Report uncertainty, lost work and meaningful experience moments as they occur.
charterSnapshot.scope: Commercial landing page through room selection, details, review and confirmed reservation, including reasonable recovery when a choice does not fit.
charterSnapshot.successCriteria: The visible saved reservation matches the persona’s purpose, capacity, projector requirement and all-in budget. Describe any remaining incompleteness precisely.
charterSnapshot.stopCriteria: A verified reservation, an observed obstacle after reasonable recovery, unsafe action or the session limits.
charterSnapshot.startingState: First visit in a new independent browser session, with no prior reservation or product knowledge.
charterSnapshot.goals: Complete one suitable test reservation and verify its details. Do not confuse a successful action with accomplishing the persona’s goal.
charterSnapshot.expectedBehaviorSources: The persona’s explicit meeting requirements, product-visible prices and requirements, and actual recorded confirmation. Preserve factual prices, room capacities and existing successful booking paths when evaluating changes.
charterSnapshot.allowedActions: Use dedicated test data within the environment policy.
